C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: The candidate identifies multiple genuine further problems, most notably floating-point precision issues with currency (along with ignored subsequent coupons), and explains why it matters (accounting and rounding discrepancies on payment gateways and receipts).

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The candidate clearly identifies who loses (the merchant/business suffering revenue loss and giving items away for free) and notes that payment systems may fail on negative values. However, it does not explicitly contrast this by stating that the zero settlement fails silently / raises nothing, falling slightly short of level 5.
